note: Kossuth County Conservation Board park 1.75 mi SE of Whittemore: a chain of old gravel pits turned fishing ponds, with a north and a south camping loop beside them, fishing docks, a small swim beach and a playground. --Claude
summary: Fees corrected $15 -> $20 (2026 county rules; the $15 on mycountyparks is stale). Water hookup cleared true -> null (only hydrants are listed). Added sites 26, showers, flush and pit toilets, dump, season mid-April to Oct 31, booking link, 5-day advance rule and the May-Sept reservation window. Pond kept: the water beside the sites is a chain of gravel pits of about 2-3 acres each.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored 'pond' kept, no view value): measured on Esri imagery by pixel fill, the pit beside the south loop (sites 19-30, and the stored pin) is ~3.2 acres (about 150 x 155 m); the next pit north ~1.9 acres; the pit across B44 ~1.9 acres; the north pits by sites 1-18 are shallow, weed-choked and broken up, and a 30-45 m wooded strip separates those sites from them. Every water body is under ~5 acres, so it is a pond, and per the rules there is no pond-view. Some south-loop pads (about 27-30) sit on the camp road with the pond just past it; whatever their exact spacing, the value stays 'pond'.
WATER HOOKUP: the stored true came from note prose ('electric + water sites'); the county lists only 'Electrical hookups' and 'Water hydrants', so I cleared it to null rather than writing false.

SITE COUNT: the 2026 rules say '13 online reservable sites and 12 walk-in sites'; the site map marks 13 walk-in (2, 7, 8, 12, 13, 17-20, 23-26); the park page says 29 campsites in all (3 of them host-only). I wrote 26.
FIT: no site length is posted anywhere; the pads are gravel, 'One camper or trailer allowed per pad', and imagery shows trailers on the south loop. Unclear rather than a problem.
PHONE: stored entry has no phone; Kossuth County Conservation Board (515) 295-2138. apply.py does not write phone.

WEBSITE: the stored link (the mycountyparks Activity/Camping page) still shows the old $15 fee; the park page https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Kossuth/Park/Siems-Park carries the 2026 rules and map and is the better link.
PIN: stored 43.05400,-94.39920 sits on the water of the south pit, ~30 m east of the south-loop pads; within tolerance, no change.
